item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 03/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will persist over southern China this week. Tropical Cyclone Nalgae will move across the western part of Guangdong today and weaken gradually. Under the influence of its outer rainbands, there will still be a few showers today. With Nalgae weakening and dissipating, the weather is expected to improve and showers will ease off gradually over the coastal areas of Guangdong in the next couple of days.

Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Cloudy with a few showers. There will be swells.
Temp range: 19 - 24 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
